scope: Kerala electricity assets, awarded/contracted pipeline, storage, grid reinforcement and sector-coupling leads relevant to a full PyPSA model. Dated statuses are preserved; project announcement is never treated as current installed capacity.
rules: Do not add named assets on top of official aggregate installed-capacity totals unless the ownership/technology bucket has been reconciled.
Keep current/commissioned, awarded/contracted, proposed/planning and historical/non-admitted assets separate.
Allocated/contracted power outside Kerala is a procurement resource, not Kerala location-based installed capacity.
MW power capacity and MWh energy capacity are distinct for storage.
A tender, PPA, PSA, LoA, regulatory approval or planning-study assumption does not prove COD.
Rooftop solar snapshots at different dates must not be summed with earlier all-solar totals.
Hydro extension, conventional hydro and pumped storage are distinct technologies unless source documents establish reversible pumping topology.
